question: Why is the food on Artemis II often so spicy?
answer: Without weight in orbit, body fluids drift up to the head and stuff the nose, somewhat like a cold. A stuffy nose makes food taste flat, so space food is made spicy and hot to taste of something again.
move: In orbit a stuffy head dulls taste; spice gives the flavour back.
